tables.Effect: Starting from Town Hall 4, the player's troops and spells are temporarily boosted to the maximum level allowed by their Town Hall level (as if under the effect of a Power Potion ).
Starting from Town Hall 4, the player's resource collectors are temporarily boosted to work at double their normal rate (as if under the effect of a Resource Potion ).

Starting from Town Hall 4, the player's Star Bonus is temporarily boosted to 4x the normal amount. This boost does not stack with any existing Star Bonus events; if active during a Star Bonus event, the best boost will override the other (so this boost would override a 2x or 3x Star Bonus event, and would be overridden by a 5x Star Bonus event).
Starting from Town Hall 8, the player's Heroes and Pets are temporarily boosted to the maximum level allowed by the Town Hall (as if under the effect of a Hero Potion ).

tables.Tapping this icon displays information a: Tapping this icon begins upgrading the Town Hall to the next level, if you have enough resources and a free Builder (or B.O.B ). When the Town Hall is at maximum level, or if the weapon for this Town Hall is not maxed, this icon is not shown.

Tapping this icon instantly upgrades the Town Hall to the next level, at the cost of one Hammer of Building if you have one. When the Town Hall is at maximum level, or if the weapon for this Town Hall is not maxed, this icon is not shown.
Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, instantly finishes that upgrade at the cost of the displayed number of Gems .

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, instantly finishes that upgrade at the cost of one Book of Building . This icon is only shown if you have at least one Book of Building.

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, instantly finishes that upgrade at the cost of one Book of Everything . This icon is only shown if you have at least one Book of Everything but do not have a Book of Building.

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, gives the player the option to assign a Builder's Apprentice to that Building. This icon only is only shown if you have unlocked Builder's Apprentice for 500 Gems .

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, boosts all your Builders for 1 hour by a factor of ten, at the cost of one Builder Potion . This icon is only shown if you have at least one Builder Potion.
Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, cancels the current upgrade and refunds half of the upgrade cost.

Tapping this icon, which is shown only when the Town Hall at level 17, begins upgrading the Inferno Artillery to the next level, if you have enough resources and a free Builder (or B.O.B). When the Town Hall's weapon is at maximum level, this icon is not shown.

Tapping this icon, which is shown only when the Town Hall is level 17, instantly upgrades the Inferno Artillery to the next level, at the cost of one Hammer of Building if you have one. When the Town Hall's weapon is at maximum level, this icon is not shown.
Tapping this icon displays information about your inventory of Magic Items .
Tapping this icon allows you to change between any Sceneries that you have unlocked.
Tapping this icon opens the Chief's Journey interface.
This icon informs you about the countdown timer of a Star Bonus boost due to a recent Town Hall upgrade.
Tapping this icon, which is shown only when the Town Hall at level 18, allows you to see the information of the Guardians , including their statistics.
